coder_notes: Imaging-schedule feasibility study (Phase NA); the only registered intervention is a diagnostic test (triggered MRI). Temozolomide listed only because every patient is planned to receive the standard Stupp regimen (manual R9); it is background care, not studied. cns5_terminology coded historical because of 'WHO grade IV' (Roman numeral, pre-CNS5 grading) with no IDH requirement; could be argued unclear. Brief summary calls it a randomized trial but design is single group.
